طَنٌّ [accord. to the CK طِنٌّ, being there said to be with kesr, but not so in other copies of the K, nor in the TA,] Fresh, ripe, red dates, very sweet, (K, TA,) and having much flowing juice; as also ↓ طُنٌّ , with damm. (TA.) ＝
-A2- Also, [if not a mistranscription for طُنٌّ,] A half-load, such as is borne on one side of a beast, of cotton that has been separated, or loosened, and cleared of its seeds: from El-Hejeree. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
